# FOX 32 Chicago

> FOX 32 Chicago (WFLD) is the primary source for Chicago-area local news, weather forecasts, sports coverage, and live streaming.

FOX 32 Chicago delivers breaking news, weather updates from meteorologists, live news streams, and coverage of Chicago sports teams including the Bears, Blackhawks, Bulls, Cubs, and White Sox. The station features on-air personalities and programming including the Good Day Chicago morning show and FOX News Sunday with Shannon Bream.
